title: Mars dynamical-spectrum row
description: One row in Mars's per-body action-angle decomposition. Two row_types coexist with shared required fields and row-type-specific optional fields, mirroring saturn_rings + mercury_dynamical_spectrum + luna_dynamical_spectrum. dynamical_mode rows (the 8 angle/action modes from MARS_DYNAMICAL_MODES) carry mode kinematics. secular_resonance rows (the 3 entries in MARS_SECULAR_RESONANCES) carry the near-resonance pairs that drive Mars obliquity chaos via secular-resonance overlap (Laskar 1993; Touma-Wisdom 1993).

name.description: Row identifier. For dynamical_mode rows: the mode name (e.g., 'spin_axis_precession', 'apsidal_precession_g4', 'obliquity'). For secular_resonance rows: a composite '<mars_mode>__<secular_partner>' label (e.g., 'spin_axis_precession__s3').

row_type.description: Row category. dynamical_mode = an angle or action variable in Mars's action-angle decomposition. secular_resonance = a near-resonance between Mars's spin-axis or apsidal precession and an inner-Solar-System secular fundamental (s₃ / s₄ / s₅ / g_i combinations) that contributes to Mars obliquity chaos.

frequency_per_century.description: Mode frequency in cycles per century (negative for retrograde modes like nodal precession). For dynamical_mode rows only; null for secular_resonance. 0.0 indicates a pure-action row (eccentricity / inclination / obliquity).

period_days.description: Equivalent period in days for cycle-class modes; 0.0 for pure-action rows. For dynamical_mode rows only; null for secular_resonance.

amplitude_value.description: Characteristic amplitude of the mode in source-units (see amplitude_units). Negative values (e.g., retrograde nodal precession at -17.74 arcsec/yr) preserve sign convention. For dynamical_mode rows only; null for secular_resonance.

amplitude_units.description: Units of amplitude_value. For dynamical_mode rows only; null for secular_resonance.

angle_or_action.description: Whether the mode is an angle variable (lives on a torus, periodic mod 2π) or an action variable (slowly varying real interval). For dynamical_mode rows only; null for secular_resonance.

mars_mode.description: Which Mars mode participates in the secular resonance (e.g., 'spin_axis_precession', 'apsidal_precession_g4'). For secular_resonance rows only; null for dynamical_mode.

secular_partner.description: The inner-Solar-System secular fundamental that participates in the resonance (e.g., 's3', 's4', 'g3-s3'). For secular_resonance rows only; null for dynamical_mode.

partner_description.description: Human-readable description of the secular partner including its frequency value. For secular_resonance rows only; null for dynamical_mode.

proximity_arcsec_per_year.description: Magnitude of |freq_mars - freq_partner| in arcsec/yr — how close the two frequencies are. Smaller values indicate stronger near-resonance and more pronounced chaos contribution. For secular_resonance rows only; null for dynamical_mode.

precision_flag.description: Per-§17.1.6 ship-readiness convention. 'high' for high-precision modern measurements (e.g., Le Maistre 2023 InSight RISE); 'medium' for secular fundamentals + Laskar ephemeris values; 'low' for the laskar_2008 approximate-pairing entry.

notes.description: Per-row free-text notes — historical context, measurement caveats, cross-references to v0.24.9 dynamical-regime classifier.

source_doi.description: DOI of the peer-reviewed paper or canonical reference authorising this row's numerical values.

source_published_date.description: ISO 8601 partial date — 'YYYY' for textbooks / historical works, 'YYYY-MM' for journal issues, 'YYYY-MM-DD' for online papers / specific historic dates.

entered_locally_at.description: ISO 8601 date when this row was first added to the AMSC catalogue.

source_version.description: Optional. For ephemeris kernels (e.g., 'DE441'), textbook editions, or archive release tags.
